description: Wire approval verification into canonical workflow transition AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL -> IMPLEMENTING. Add approval guard that blocks transition when approval is missing, invalid, or verification fails. This feature depends on FEAT-001 (ImplementationApproval model) and FEAT-002 (approval storage).
steps: Read services/project-ai/app/orchestration/canonical_workflow.py to understand existing transition validation (is_valid_transition function and VALID_TRANSITIONS dict)
Create new function: can_transition_to_implementing(workflow_id: str, approvals_store: Dict[str, ImplementationApproval]) -> Tuple[bool, str]
Function returns (True, '') if valid approval exists with all verifications passing
Function returns (False, 'reason') if: approval missing, status != APPROVED, workflow_id mismatch, any hash mismatch, self-approved, or expired (if expiry exists)

Approval verification checks: (1) ImplementationApproval record exists for workflow_id, (2) approval.status == APPROVED, (3) approval.workflow_id matches, (4) all hashes match (candidate_sha256, placement_manifest_sha256), (5) not self-approved
Add transition guard to existing AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL -> IMPLEMENTING transition: call can_transition_to_implementing() before allowing transition
Transition must be BLOCKED (return False + reason) if approval verification fails
Do NOT create second workflow engine or state machine - CanonicalWorkflowState remains ONLY lifecycle authority
Do NOT modify TaskState - it remains internal agent execution state only

Test cases: transition requires valid approval (success), transition blocked without approval, transition blocked with PENDING approval, transition blocked with REJECTED approval, transition blocked on candidate hash mismatch, transition blocked on manifest hash mismatch, transition blocked on self-approval
Use mock approvals_store dict with sample ImplementationApproval records for testing
acceptance_criteria: Function checks: approval exists, status=APPROVED, workflow_id matches, hashes match, not self-approved
Function returns (True, '') only when all checks pass
Function returns (False, reason) with descriptive reason when any check fails
AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL -> IMPLEMENTING transition calls approval guard before allowing transition
Transition succeeds when valid approval exists
Transition is blocked when approval missing (returns False)
Transition is blocked when approval status != APPROVED
Transition is blocked when any hash mismatch
All test cases pass: pytest tests/test_workflow_transitions.py shows 100% pass rate
